ctx.x: But I mean, I would- He had some old records of Lee Collins, sounded real good on those, back 1928 or 1909. Yeah.

But now, I wouldn't dare put Joe in a class with Steve, or even Walter Pichon. Walter Pichon was another genius. Well, he stayed and he kept practicing until he made something out of it. Now, I had- At one time we had some records in there. We promised to try to copy them, but we were going to get somebody to write down the melodies of them and see if we could get an arrangement on them for about a six piece and play them.
I mean, I know there's some old records, Jerry Roll and Morton and all that stuff.
